deferred_items.item: Reverse links from reference/thread-atlas.html and reference/metric-thread-atlas.html to the Tapping Atlas
deferred_items.reason: Both files are generator-produced by unrelated pipelines (generate-thread-atlas-page.js and generate-atlas-page.js respectively, each with their own projection). Adding a link properly would require modifying foreign generator architecture outside the tapping domain; hand-editing the HTML output directly would create silent-drift risk (the edit would be lost on next regeneration) -- both against the phase's explicit scope discipline ('do not create a second tapping architecture', 'do not touch unrelated architecture'). Existing one-way links (Atlas -> Thread Atlas, Atlas -> Metric Thread Atlas) plus the shared reference/index.html hub already provide a discovery path.
deferred_items.recommendation: If desired, a future phase scoped specifically to those generators could add this reverse link
